comment: M19 part-time jobs: after a shift (a location activity with 'job'), one of these small events may play: a quick choice with a little extra money, stats or Bond.

deli.title: The lunch rush
deli.text: Six orders at once. Gary throws you an apron and a look.

choices.label: Take the orders fast
choices.result: Nobody waits. Gary nods. Tips jar: up.

choices.label: Chat with the regulars
choices.result: You learn who's feuding with who. Gary smirks.

deli.title: The secret recipe
deli.text: Gary leaves the recipe book open on the counter. Accidentally. Probably.

choices.label: Peek
choices.result: It just says 'more salt'. You feel cheated.

forge.title: Hot iron
forge.text: The blacksmith hands you the tongs. The iron is the colour of a sunset.

choices.label: Strike it hard
choices.result: Sparks everywhere. One lands on your sleeve. Worth it.

hospital.title: A frightened patient
hospital.text: A kid in a cast won't stop asking about the woods.

choices.label: Tell them it's fine
choices.result: They believe you. You almost do.

library.title: The back shelf
library.text: Ms. Marlowe asks you to reshelve a cart. One book has no title and no barcode.

choices.label: Read a page
choices.result: It's about you. It's about tomorrow. You put it back.
